# Screen Description

This is a photo of a **smartphone (iPhone-style)** displaying a web browser with a payment/checkout page. The photo is taken in a dimly lit environment showing someone's hand holding the phone.

## Browser/Status Bar
- **Time:** 11:43, with alarm and battery icons; battery at **78%**
- **Wi-Fi and signal indicators** visible at top right
- **URL:** `akuosplash.cl/akuosp...` (partially visible)
- Browser controls: home icon, **+** (new tab), tab counter showing **51**, and a three-dot menu

## Error Message (pink/red banner with ❗ icon)
> **"No se pudo iniciar el pago: Both payer and collector must be real or test users"**

This is a MercadoPago error indicating a mismatch between test/production user accounts.

## Checkout Page Content
- A partially hidden blue button (text obscured by the error banner)
- **Coupon section:** "🎫 ¿Tenés un cupón?" with input field showing placeholder **"EJ: BIENVENIDA50"** and a **"Validar"** button
- **Order summary:**
  - **Plan:** Pro
  - **Ciclo:** Mensual
  - **Subtotal:** $23.990
  - **Total:** $23.990 (bold)
  - **Comisión marketplace:** 8.5%
  - **MP split mode:** Split

## Payment Button
- Large blue button with card icon: **"Pagar con MercadoPago"** (a finger/thumb is touching/near it)

## Footer Text (partially visible)
> "...o a MercadoPago para autorizar la ...rrente. Después de aprobar, volvés ...utomáticamente acá."

(Translate: text about being redirected to MercadoPago to authorize the current payment, and returning automatically after approval.)

**In summary:** A Spanish-language checkout page for a "Pro" monthly plan ($23,990 CLP) on akuosplash.cl attempting MercadoPago payment in split mode, which fails with a test/production user configuration error.
